title: Improve pre-defined settings on watch calculator
symptom: Users and school assistants use AAPS watch to bolus for meals with all calculator features ON, but when BG is rising fast, the positive trend produces a high amount of insulin that is not necessary. They want more configuration options on the watch calculator preset settings, similar to quickwizard, especially choosing trend positive, negative, all, or OFF.
evidence_quote: I would love the option for more configuration on the watch calculator preset settings, similar to what is possible on the quickwizard. Especially choosing trend that is positive, negative, all or OFF.
